`final class NodeDrawEvent<N extends Node>`<br/>
**Extends:** [`NodeEvent<N>`](/reference/events/nodeevent/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.event.impl.node` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [NodeDrawEvent.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/event/impl/node/NodeDrawEvent.java)

The event of `onDraw` and `onRender`, with the position of the pointer on the frame being drawn.

## Description

[`Node.onDraw`](/reference/nodes/node/#Node-event-onDraw) fires right after the node drew itself, before its children in front of it; [`Node.onRender`](/reference/nodes/node/#Node-event-onRender) fires after the node, its children and its layers.
A listener draws there with [`DrawUtils`](/reference/drawing/drawutils/), in the coordinates of the parent.
